summary: E2E empresa KYC/verification flow validated end-to-end via Playwright with cookie-based auth. All critical acceptance checks pass: /company shows Verificación + Seguridad tabs; clicking Verificación navigates to /company/kyc and renders company-kyc-page (not personal identity form); form collects fiscal code + legal address + 2 docs (image + PDF supported); submit button is disabled until all fields+docs ready; POST /api/kyc/company/submit returns 200; status flips to 'En revisión' (company-kyc-settled). Wallet verification gate works: /company/wallet withdraw button triggers verification-gate-banner with gate-cta-kyc that routes to /company/kyc (not bouncing to /company). Admin review: /admin/kyc shows kyc-row-company-* with Empresa badge; approve dialog (kyc-action-dialog) shows kyc-company-badge, kyc-company-fields with fiscal_code+legal_address, tax_certificate as image and operating_license as 'Ver PDF' link. Approve request returns 200 and empresa final status becomes 'Verificada'.
critical_code_review_comments: CompanyKYCView.jsx (272 LOC) acceptable but refs object recreated every render (fileRefs object literal in function body) - minor; useRef values are stable but outer object identity changes. Not functional bug.
test_credentials: Cookie session_token=test_session_empresa_e2e_X (user_test_empresa_e2e, role=empresa) and session_token=test_session_admin_X (admin). Seeded via /app/backend/tests/_seed_empresa_e2e.py
seed_data_creation: Seeded user_test_empresa_e2e (empresa, active, email+phone verified, kyc=unverified) + session; also upserted admin session. KYC verification created and approved during run; final kyc_status=verified.
context_for_next_testing_agent: To re-run: `python /app/backend/tests/_seed_empresa_e2e.py` then use cookies on preview. PNG+PDF fixtures at /tmp/test_tax.png and /tmp/test_license.pdf. The approve button inside kyc-row-company-* uses data-testid=kyc-approve-btn-<verification_id> (NOT nested inside the row element in DOM; select at page level).
